archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Future, Speed, Disruption) mixed with THE SWISS GRID

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max size is text-6xl. Do not jump more than 2 tailwind scale steps between heading and subheading. Use JetBrains Mono for all hardware specs, voltages, and datasheet links.

colors.rules: Never use pure black. Tint background towards deep blue to match logo. Use #00FF66 exclusively for primary CTAs and active states. Maintain 4.5:1 contrast for text.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have border-r border-b border-border/40. No soft shadows. Sharp 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Implement 'The Tracing Beam' for featured product cards. Glow effect on hover with blur-md behind the primary accent color.
visual_enhancers.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050A0F]/70 with a 1px bottom border border-white/10. NO pure transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire background to kill digital flatness and simulate raw hardware feel.

grids_layouts.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24. Generous padding. Use p-8 for standard component internal padding.
grids_layouts.bento_grid: Homepage categories and featured items use MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. gap-8. Mix col-span-8 row-span-2 with smaller supporting blocks. Leave empty cells for negative space.
grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: Admin panel uses MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-4. Single metric summaries use col-span-1. Main charts use col-span-3.
grids_layouts.alignment: Strict left alignment for specs, data tables, and product descriptions. Center align ONLY massive hero text if absolutely necessary for balance.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). High contrast. Primary buttons: bg-[#00FF66] text-black hover:bg-[#00CC52]. Ghost buttons: border border-white/20 hover:border-white/50.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic. Flat rectangular shapes with 1px border. No shadows. Technical blueprint vibe.
components.datasheet_table: Dense, monospace font (JetBrains Mono), subtle zebra striping with bg-white/5. Hover row highlight.
components.forms_inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized to be flat, square, with 1px borders. Focus state: ring-1 ring-[#00FF66] ring-offset-0.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must have transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO universal 'transition-all'.
motion.page_load: Staggered entrance for product grids and dashboard widgets (framer-motion).

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. Text over images must have background overlay (bg-black/50 max) or text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-submit').

images.description: Macro shot of integrated circuits. Use with a dark overlay (bg-black/50) for the main landing hero.
Engineer in laboratory with robotic equipment.
Electronic circuit boards near tester, wires, workspace.
ElectronicHub blue-and-green circuit-styled globe with robotic arm. MUST USE this exact path.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for high-end technical UI. Use Duotone weight for marketing, Regular for dense admin.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2D layout animations. For product showcases, if a 3D view is added later, use React Three Fiber. For this MVP, stick to high-quality images and crisp CSS grids to maintain blueprint precision.

instructions_to_main_agent: This project uses .js/.jsx files (not .tsx). Adjust all component installations and imports accordingly.
Install fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Install date tools & framer-motion: yarn add date-fns framer-motion
Install sonner for toasts: yarn add sonner
Use Shadcn UI for dropdowns, selects, tabs, and tables. Strip rounded corners to 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' to maintain the technical hardware feel.
Build the storefront and admin panel within the same React app using conditional routing or sub-paths (/admin).
For the product detail page, create a 'Specs' tab and a 'Datasheet' download button. Datasheet should look highly technical.
For filtering in the catalog, use a left-sidebar with Checkboxes for Voltage, Interface, Brand.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all buttons, form inputs, and major links for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. (For this app, use sharp edges).
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner components are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .jsx.
